title: Protocol and Border
author: Dominic Thackeray
blurb: Silas Voss, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
